usageNotes: Use this to inspect the Debian/apt changelog for a package on a remote PVE node before deciding whether to apply an update — useful for reviewing what changes are included in a pending upgrade. The `name` query parameter is required and must match the exact Debian package name; omit `version` to retrieve the changelog for the currently available candidate version. The remote must be reachable and the calling user must hold `Resource.Modify` on the remote/node/system path.

examples.summary: Fetch the changelog for the pve-manager package at its candidate version on a remote node

tips: If you need the changelog for a specific installed version rather than the candidate, supply the `version` query parameter (e.g., the version string shown by `apt-cache show`).
Returns a plain-text string — the full Debian changelog — so expect a multi-line block of text, not a structured object.
The remote ID must satisfy the pattern ^(?:[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._\-]*)$ with a length of 2–32 characters; double-check the remote name if you receive a validation error.
